hypotheses.justification: The result also holds for the only odd base below 3, namely p = 1: then (1^m - 1) / 2 = 0 and LowDigits 1 0 holds because Nat.digits 1 0 = []. For p ≠ 1, Odd p implies 3 ≤ p, so the existing induction applies. Thus hp can be removed, handling p = 1 separately and deriving 3 ≤ p otherwise.
